statement: User gets Blender-equivalent Spreadsheet editor infrastructure through shared UI infrastructure (7 operators in bpy.ops.spreadsheet), verified by common tests instead of one test per operator.
notes: UI-infrastructure group row. Member operators (7): bpy.ops.spreadsheet.add_row_filter_rule = Add Row Filter; bpy.ops.spreadsheet.change_spreadsheet_data_source = Change Visible Data Source; bpy.ops.spreadsheet.fit_column = Fit Column; bpy.ops.spreadsheet.remove_row_filter_rule = Remove Row Filter; bpy.ops.spreadsheet.reorder_columns = Reorder Columns; bpy.ops.spreadsheet.resize_column = Resize Column; bpy.ops.spreadsheet.toggle_pin = Toggle Pin
